author.name: Reliability Ruth
author.role: Develops the end-user applications and services that integrate ML models. Handles model deployment, configuration, and continuous monitoring of real-world performance. Employs feedback loops to facilitate iterative improvements and system reliability.

challenge.name: The Locked Shadow
challenge.description: A supplier contract for the next promotion week is already signed, and the team cannot deploy the new model without a shadow run to verify it. #reliability_ruth# demands a fully automated and governed shadow environment to protect the live forecast, while #automation_alex# insists on keeping it manual to avoid breaking the current pipeline stability.

output.content: We need the shadow environment for the new model to be fully automated and governed. I want a formal sign off before any output touches the live forecast. The more rigorous the approval process, the better. I am not asking for a quick check. I want a strict, documented review that catches every drift or serving failure before it reaches the stores. If we automate the shadow run and add full governance, we can trust the results. I am open to adding more review steps if it helps ensure the live pipeline stays safe. I want this to be airtight.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states that more rigor and additional review steps would make them happier, indicating that exceeding the minimum requirements aligns with their goal of ensuring safety.
